reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that groups related skills into bundle boxes and loads root or selected sub-skills on demand to reduce unnecessary model-context usage.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的技能束加载插件，可按元数据或模型决策按需加载相关根技能和子技能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that organizes related skills into bundles and loads root or selected sub-skills on demand.

capabilities: Reads local skill bundle metadata and markdown bodies
Loads selected sub-skill content into the model context
Provides tools to load or browse skills by name
